title: cynanchum pauciflorum
intro: Cynanchum pauciflorum, commonly known as Wild Chrysanthemum or Chinese Swallowwort, is a plant species in the Apocynaceae family. This plant has been traditionally used in Chinese medicine to treat various health conditions, offering health benefits such as anti-inflammatory and antioxidant properties, as well as potential cardiovascular and neuroprotective effects. The therapeutic actions of Cynanchum pauciflorum include vasodilation, anti-anxiety, and sedative effects, which are attributed to its bioactive constituents, including iridoid glycosides, phenylethanoid glycosides, and flavonoids.
